subject_line: Featuring the story behind The Snot Strikes Back
email_body:
Hi J.J.,

Your Iggy & Oz series caught my attention, especially how you describe it as a mix of the mystery of Scooby-Doo, the friendship of The Goonies, and the creepy fun of Goosebumps set in a gated suburban neighborhood. Seeing The Snot Strikes Back, with its escaped Sasquatch and a living blob of snot, going to Kickstarter this October made me smile.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

Since you are launching a new Iggy & Oz adventure, one option is a short cinematic trailer or a few promotional reels for The Snot Strikes Back. If that is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, and it would be a completely optional add-on to the feature.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you like to hear more about the feature and the option I believe would suit The Snot Strikes Back best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
